description: Figure 5 is a grouped vertical bar chart illustrating, for three content domains, the proportion (in percent) of incorrectly answered samples satisfying the condition that \( \mathrm{RPop}_{Ge} < \mathrm{RPop}_{GT} \), with separate bars for different LLMs. The horizontal axis contains the category labels “Movies,” “Songs,” and “Basketball” (left to right), and the vertical axis is labeled “Ratio (%)” on a linear scale spanning roughly 50 to 90 with tick marks at 50, 60, 70, 80, and 90. Each category shows three adjacent bars corresponding to the legend entries at the top: Llama3 (blue), Qwen2 (red), and ChatGPT (yellow). For Movies, the blue bar is near 90%, the red bar is near 90%, and the yellow bar is around the low-to-mid 70% range. For Songs, the blue bar is in the mid-80% range, the red bar is near 90%, and the yellow bar is around the low 60% range. For Basketball, the blue bar is around the upper 60% range, the red bar is around the upper 50% range, and the yellow bar is around the mid-40% range (slightly below the plotted y-axis minimum of 50, appearing truncated at the bottom). The bars are not visually emphasized with annotations or outlines, and the categories do not appear to be sorted by bar height.
